Description.name: Shugajo
Description.description: The perfectionist of the Shugafam, this fastidious fellow values precision and detail above all else. It follows that the Shugajo is the namesake of an instrument that requires a finely-honed technique. The secret to its success? Soothing daily mudbaths, which keep the mind clear and the limbs limber (and tinted a rich, chocolatey brown).
